mapper.select: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, c.course_info, MAX(CASE WHEN col.user_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_favorite, MAX(CASE WHEN col.user_id = #{userId} THEN ci.create_at ELSE NULL END) AS favorite_time FROM inver.courses c LEFT JOIN inver.collection_items ci ON c.course_id = ci.item_id AND ci.item_type = 'course' LEFT JOIN inver.collections col ON ci.collection_id = col.collection_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name, c.course_info ORDER BY is_favorite DESC, favorite_time DESC, c.course_id ASC;
SELECT * FROM courses WHERE course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR course_info LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
